review.batchSummary:
Part 1/5: Reviewed 2 items (each has two context-only variants with identical metadata). Both items measure straightforward grammar skills and their supplied metadata are appropriate.

Part 2/5: Reviewed 2 English-writing items (S3, part 2 of 5). Both items assess straightforward aspects of language use: appropriate word selection in context and register/formality for audience. Metadata largely aligns with the measured skills; no substantive changes required.

Part 3/5: Reviewed 2 items (and their context-only variants) for alignment between the assessed skill in the stem/hint/options and the supplied label, topic and module. Both items appropriately label the tested skills and have coherent module assignments.

Part 4/5: Reviewed 2 items (each applies to two context-only variants). Both items measure targeted sentence-level writing skills (use of cohesive connectors; revising vague statements for specificity). Metadata fields are appropriate; no substantive revisions required.

Part 5/5: Reviewed 2 English-writing S3 items (editing and pre-writing planning). Both items measure the skills indicated by their metadata and require no substantive changes.

reviews.reason: The stem and hint require selecting the correct past-tense verb form. The supplied topic and label 'Grammar and tense' accurately describe the skill (specifically past simple tense), and the module '基礎掌握' (basic mastery) is appropriate for this core-level item.

The task tests subject–verb agreement (recognising that 'each' takes a singular verb). The current topic and label 'Subject–verb agreement' correctly name the tested skill, and '基礎掌握' suits a core-level grammar item.

The item asks students to choose the best word to complete a sentence based on meaning and context. This directly measures vocabulary/word-choice ability. The provided label 'Word choice' and topic 'Vocabulary and context' accurately describe the skill; the module '基礎掌握' is appropriate for a core-level vocabulary item.

The item requires selecting the sentence that fits a formal register and audience (a teacher). This assesses understanding of register/tone and audience-appropriate phrasing. The label 'Register' and the topic 'Register and tone (formality and audience)' correctly describe the measured skill; the module '基礎掌握' suits this core-level pragmatic language item.

The item asks students to select the best topic sentence introducing a paragraph about an environmental campaign, which is directly about paragraph organisation and identifying a central idea. The label and topic accurately describe this skill. The module '整合表達' (integrated expression) is an acceptable, coherent placement for a writing/paragraph-organisation task.

The item requires identifying a specific supporting detail that backs up the claim that planning improves a project. The label 'Supporting detail' and topic 'Identifying supporting details' accurately reflect the measured skill. The module '理解與應用' (comprehension and application) is appropriate for this reading/writing comprehension task.
The item assesses choice of an appropriate connective to show cause/consequence (cohesion). The label 'Cohesion', topic 'Writing expression', and module '理解與應用' coherently describe the skill.

The item requires revising a vague sentence to be specific and concrete, matching the label 'Precision and specificity (revising vague statements)' and topic 'Sentence specificity and precision in writing'. The module '理解與應用' is appropriate.
reviews.recommendedTopic: Sentence specificity and precision in writing

reviews.reason: The item asks students to identify a sentence that violates parallel structure. The label 'Editing', topic 'Sentence structure — parallelism (editing)', and module '理解與應用' accurately describe the targeted skill (editing for parallelism within sentence lists/verb phrases).

The item asks which pre-writing step best prevents going off-topic by planning purpose, audience, key points and examples. The label 'Writing planning (pre-writing) strategy', topic 'Pre-writing planning and composition planning', and module '理解與應用' correctly reflect the skill being assessed (planning a composition to stay on topic).
